handover_report.title: EverythingAI / EverythingApp — UserApp Refactor Milestone Handover
handover_report.prepared_for: Next AI engineering agent / continuation session

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule. Do not create long-lived feature branches by default.

executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI is a local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace for indexing local files, extracting content, browsing generated Wiki-style knowledge pages, searching indexed sources, and asking source-grounded questions.
executive_summary.milestone_summary: The frontend user app controller has been significantly modularized. UserApp.tsx is no longer a large state-heavy component; most reusable state and several API workflows have been extracted into focused hooks under apps/everything-ai-ui/src/user/.
executive_summary.current_mvp_status: Frontend typecheck and production build are passing after the refactor. Backend baseline remains documented as 80 tests passing. Phase 6 UI/Wiki polish is nearly complete, with UserApp refactoring now advanced enough for continuation without forcing risky broad changes.
executive_summary.strategic_direction: The project is moving from a file organizer/search app toward an evidence-backed operational knowledge workspace, where AI-derived knowledge is traceable to source files, citations, chunks, and evidence metadata.

frontend.user_reported_output_summary: TypeScript completed with no errors. Vite production build completed successfully with 1533 modules transformed.

backend.source: Previously recorded MVP finalization validation. Backend was not rerun during this UserApp refactor batch.

main_controller.role: Thin orchestration layer for the official safe user UI. It composes hooks and page views, coordinates navigation, and keeps the central onboarding/build flow visible.

views.role: Start/setup UI for selecting folder, showing setup progress, and building the local knowledge workspace.
Explore/search UI for indexed files and document context.
Wiki/knowledge page UI with reading mode, source rail, source evidence actions, and citation interactions.

hooks.status: created but not wired into UserApp.tsx because a full controller patch was blocked once by connector safety checks. Current app state is validated and stable without forcing this change.

what_intentionally_remains_in_userapp.reasoning: UserApp.tsx should remain the visible orchestration layer. The central onboarding workflow should not be hidden too early because it touches folder selection, indexing, extraction, insights, Wiki loading, file loading, document context loading, setup progress, view navigation, and user-facing status messages.

important_known_limitations.limitation: Connector safety checks blocked some large or broad file replacements.
important_known_limitations.impact: Large MVP plan updates and full UserApp controller rewrites may be blocked. Use smaller patches or dedicated documentation notes instead.

important_known_limitations.limitation: The Ask workflow hook exists but is not wired yet.
important_known_limitations.impact: No runtime problem is expected because UserApp.tsx still owns askQuestion(). Do not force this refactor unless there is a clear reason and a small safe patch can be accepted.
This is intentional. It should stay visible until the broader MVP smoke test is complete.

important_known_limitations.limitation: Large docs/MVP_FINALIZATION_PLAN.md replacements have been blocked before.
important_known_limitations.impact: Prefer focused validation notes in docs/ and smaller targeted documentation files.

recommended_next_steps.task: Stop major UserApp refactoring temporarily and run broader MVP smoke testing.
recommended_next_steps.reason: Frontend typecheck/build is green after many refactor batches. The next risk is not TypeScript but runtime behavior across indexing, Wiki, Explore, Ask, source drawer, and folder selection.

recommended_next_steps.task: Run local user UI smoke test on Windows.
suggested_steps: Start backend and frontend using the documented local debug flow.
Verify Start page local settings guidance renders correctly.
Select or enter a safe local test folder.
Verify Explore loads files and document context.
Verify Wiki loads pages, citations, source rail, and source preview drawer.
Verify Ask can answer a question and show sources.

recommended_next_steps.task: Update or create a Windows smoke-test manual after runtime testing.
recommended_next_steps.reason: Phase 7 still needs Windows smoke-test documentation aligned with the current validated frontend behavior.

recommended_next_steps.task: Only after smoke testing, consider wiring useAskWorkflows.ts into UserApp.tsx with a very small patch.
recommended_next_steps.reason: The hook exists, but the app is already validated. Avoid forcing this unless needed.

recommended_next_steps.task: Keep buildKnowledgeWorkspace() in UserApp.tsx until the local MVP is runtime-smoke-tested.
recommended_next_steps.reason: It is the central onboarding orchestration and should remain easy to inspect.

do_not_do_next: Do not broadly rewrite UserApp.tsx in one large patch.
Do not combine UX changes and workflow refactors in one commit.
Do not move buildKnowledgeWorkspace() before smoke testing.
Do not claim runtime validation beyond typecheck/build unless the user actually runs the app and reports results.
Do not update large documentation files by full replacement if connector safety checks block them; use focused docs/ validation notes instead.
